units.function: Minimal tests for instance-scoped SSH fixture state path and missing-fixture Doctor status.
units.dependencyDirection: Calls env-lab path/status helpers only; no SSH server/client or runtime executes.
units.keyDataModels: Instance ID, SSH fixture state path, supported/running flags and nullable environment descriptor.
units.lifecycle: Resolves a state path and reports a stopped missing fixture.
units.testAssessment: Focused Vitest passed 2/2. It proves path shape and absent-state projection only; SSH trust, credentials, process/network isolation, commands/files, cleanup/recovery and adversarial instance IDs are absent.
units.designRationale: Provide deterministic local SSH-environment fixtures for testing adapters and diagnostics.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs reproducible Connector execution-node conformance tests without confusing fixtures with real Agents or production isolation.
units.companyOsFit: REFERENCE ONLY. Build a vendor-neutral Connector conformance harness with explicit fixture labels, host-key pinning, ephemeral credentials, lifecycle cleanup, capability/pause/resume/cancel/evidence tests and secret-free runtime attestation.
units.responsibilityConflict: Fixture running status is not proof of who authorized work, which Agent/Connector executed it or what evidence was produced.
evidence: 2026-08-18 focused Vitest: 2 passed in combined 11-test run

units.function: CLI tests for feedback trace querying, report rendering and local export bundle/ZIP generation.
units.dependencyDirection: Uses shared FeedbackTrace plus client render/export/ZIP helpers; it does not invoke server consent, redaction or external upload services.
units.keyDataModels: Company/user/Agent/work IDs, vote/reason/excerpt, destination, consent/schema/bundle/payload versions, digest/redaction summaries, payload snapshot, retry/export status and manifest.
units.lifecycle: Builds a filtered payload query, summarizes traces, renders text and writes votes/traces/manifest/ZIP locally.
units.testAssessment: Focused Vitest passed 4/4. The governance-shaped model is valuable, but includePayload is forced, includePayloads:false still renders payload reason, local_only payloads export, and redaction/digest/consent/upload/retention/security are unproven.
units.designRationale: Make feedback sharing inspectable and portable with explicit consent/version/status metadata.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS must govern enterprise feedback, evidence and product-improvement exports through explicit data contracts and egress controls.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the versioned trace/destination/consent/redaction/digest model, but enforce field-level minimization server-side, make includePayloads effective, separate local review from external export, require destination/data-contract approval, encryption/signature/retention and accountable export evidence.
units.responsibilityConflict: The fixture records author IDs and consent version but no human approver for the exact outbound bundle; null digest/redaction cannot bind approval to exported bytes.
evidence: 2026-08-18 focused Vitest: 4 passed in combined 11-test run

units.function: Shared API client tests for bearer/run headers, ignored 404, request/connection errors and interactive auth recovery retry.
units.dependencyDirection: Calls production HTTP client with mocked fetch; no server identity or authorization logic executes.
units.keyDataModels: API base, bearer token, caller run ID, HTTP status/message/details, connection URL/method/cause and recoverAuth callback.
units.lifecycle: Sends JSON, maps errors, presents recovery guidance and replays a failed POST once with a newly recovered board token.
units.testAssessment: Focused Vitest passed 5/5. Basic envelope/errors work, but the suite codifies generic 403 privilege recovery and non-idempotent POST replay; stable codes, timeout/cancel, redirect/TLS/origin, size/type and redaction are missing.
units.designRationale: Centralize CLI API behavior and transparently recover an interactive board session when access fails.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS clients need reliable, tenant-safe requests without silently changing principal or repeating high-risk effects.
units.companyOsFit: REJECT the generic 403 recover-and-replay contract. Distinguish 401 refresh from authorization denial, never escalate persona automatically, require idempotency/effect digest and renewed human confirmation for mutations, and add trusted origins, timeouts, bounds, stable error codes and redacted diagnostics.
units.responsibilityConflict: Replaying an Agent/limited-principal POST with a board token changes who acts and what authority applies without rebinding the action to accountable human intent or exact effect evidence.
evidence: 2026-08-18 focused Vitest: 5 passed in combined 11-test run
